mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 0.2 percentage points in the last month triggers higher inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE rising >0.2pp, or the rise is not sustained beyond the month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in GDPC1 below 19,000 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars triggers reduced corporate investment and profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur despite GDPC1 falling below 19,000, or the contraction is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals dual pressure on equity valuations, compressing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rising, or their correlation is below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or their correlation is below 0.7.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS amplifies equity valuation growth by reducing discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite FEDFUNDS declining in a late-cycle expansion, or the expansion is not late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained rise in UNRATE above 3.5% signals inflation concerns, prompting market adjustments that result in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite UNRATE rising above 3.5 in a post-shock recovery, or the recovery is not post-shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above 105.6 (as of t-2mo) indicates robust production growth, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite INDPRO rising above 105.5973, or the supply growth is not sustained.
